policy.scope: Holy Grail Layer 3 hard eligibility only (not ranking).

alcohol.matrix: Production PASS/FAIL matrix; WITHHELD and missing → FAIL.
alcohol.softPass: NONE_ONLY × partner RARE: SOFT_PASS only when holyGrailDeterministicHalfPass(ALCOHOL_NONE_ONLY_RARE, searcherProfileId, counterpartyProfileId) is true (~50% of ordered pairs); reason ALCOHOL_NONE_ONLY_RARE_SOFT. Otherwise FAIL.
alcohol.excluded: No SOFT_PASS for MODERATE_OK×FREQUENT, PREFER_NOT_TO_SAY, missing, or any cell other than NONE_ONLY×RARE.

partnerWantsChildren.softPass: MUST_WANT × partner UNSURE → SOFT_PASS; reason WANTS_CHILDREN_MUST_WANT_UNSURE_SOFT; sets children_unsure.
partnerWantsChildren.hard: All other combinations use hard PASS/FAIL/SKIPPED (including MUST_NOT_WANT × UNSURE → FAIL).

versusPermissiveExperimentSummary.note: Earlier experiments used simulated AGE buffer, RELIGION SOFT_PASS, 100% ALCOHOL matrix softening, and/or MUST_NOT×UNSURE softening — all removed from production and from this script.
versusPermissiveExperimentSummary.alcoholVersusUltraPermissive: Ultra treated every NONE_ONLY×RARE matrix FAIL as SOFT_PASS (~100% of those fails). Locked policy uses deterministic partial softening (~50% of ordered searcher→counterparty pairs).
versusPermissiveExperimentSummary.partnerWantsChildrenVersusUltraPermissiv: Ultra softened all hard fails on this dimension. Locked policy: only MUST_WANT×UNSURE is SOFT_PASS; MUST_NOT×UNSURE remains FAIL.
